title: Yellowed Brown Australian Lamb Skewers
description: A pungent and savory Australian dish featuring lamb skewers with a blend of sansho and render fat, perfect for a midnight craving, and dairy-free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together sansho powder, render fat, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the lamb, onion, and bell pepper pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
